panels.is: T1 Passeig de Gracia, Barcelona, at dusk after rain: long-lens view down the avenue from a balcony; the march fills this side, police line ~185 m away by the burning container; Tibidabo on the ridge beyond
T2 Frankfurt at night, wet street: a gun store square-on, steel shutter half up, one big lit window of guns on white shelves, WAFFEN sign band, doorway left, closed shop right, street lamp

T3 Place de la Republique, Paris, by day from 0.8 m: Marianne monument on its drum with seated figures, black smoke behind, Haussmann fronts and trees; a burnt-out car at the bottom-left edge, burning hire bikes and a burning kiosk between the two lines
T4 Tirana avenue at dusk under a burning sky: the bank left, the yellow Education Ministry ablaze centre-right with its rounded corner and roof flag, umbrella pines and pastel blocks down the avenue
panels.beat: the worst riot: the ministry burns
